naming_policy: Every explicit proof premise in local Lean theorem/lemma signatures is named h... or _h.... Ordinary carrier, function, predicate, and data arguments are parameters rather than theorem assumptions. The checker requires every such proof-premise binder to appear exactly once here.

categories.structural: Context included to state the theorem or situate a stronger scenario, but not a load-bearing premise of the conclusion.
categories.definitional: A branch guard, constructor membership fact, or direct projection premise whose necessity follows from the declared local definition rather than a separate mathematical theorem program.
categories.substantive: A load-bearing mathematical premise for which dropping the premise can make the conclusion false; a registered countermodel/necessity witness is required.

assumptions.rationale: The trace definition is a conjunction at a cons cell; the tail theorem is direct projection of the second conjunct.
Without the no-edge premise an unmediated outside-to-inside edge can violate separator status.
Parent membership is one constructor branch of the declared family-closure disjunction.
Child membership is one constructor branch of the declared family-closure disjunction.
Co-parent membership is one constructor branch of the declared family-closure disjunction.
Reachable-future inclusion need not hold when the after relation contains a transition absent from the before relation.
Dropping preservation by the first map can make composed preservation fail.
Dropping preservation by the second map can make composed preservation fail.
Postcomposition cannot repair arbitrary noncommutation; identity observation preserves a counterexample.
Inactive is a direct false conjunct of the declared finite covers predicate.
Expired is negated as a direct conjunct of the declared finite covers predicate.
External effect and external-write permission are direct Boolean guards in covers.
External effect and external-write permission are direct Boolean guards in covers.
Current-turn authorization is the left operand of the declared authorization disjunction.
Source coverage does not transport to an unrelated narrower/denying profile without the profile-order premise.
Profile order alone does not imply that the source, and therefore target, covers a selected intent.
The join does not invent coverage absent from both inputs.
The join does not invent coverage absent from both inputs; the witness is symmetric.
A later frame can collapse a pair separated by the earlier frame if pointwise monotonicity is removed.
Pointwise monotonicity does not make an arbitrary selected pair zero-distance.
Zero scaling collapses separated pairs, so strict positivity is required for exact zero-kernel preservation.
Without membership in the staged zero kernel there is no basis for concluding membership in the earlier zero kernel.
An unconstrained undo can erase the newest event and return exactly to the predecessor reflective state.
The inverse-world hypothesis situates the stronger scenario but is deliberately unused: reflective irreversibility follows from history monotonicity independently of base-world reversibility.
The reflective no-undo conclusion still depends on the history-monotonicity admissibility condition.
Without a recovery witness, a later map may identify distinct protected coordinates; the finite collapse map witnesses the failure.
Mask inclusion directly transports each active coordinate of the smaller mask into the jointly enforced larger mask.
Admissibility under the larger mask is the source proposition projected coordinate by coordinate into the smaller mask.
Missing exit selects the first stop branch of the declared PlayEnvelope gate.
Available exit bypasses the first stop branch so the portability guard is reached.
Missing portability selects the checkpoint branch of the declared PlayEnvelope gate.
Available exit bypasses the first stop branch so later play guards are reached.
Available portability bypasses its checkpoint branch so the forkability guard is reached.
Missing forkability selects the checkpoint branch of the declared PlayEnvelope gate.
Available exit bypasses the hard stop branch in the local-play case.
Available portability bypasses the portability checkpoint in the local-play case.
Available forkability bypasses the forkability checkpoint in the local-play case.
Absent consequential authorization selects proceed rather than report after all non-capture guards pass.
Available exit bypasses the hard stop branch in the authorized-promotion case.
Available portability bypasses the portability checkpoint in the authorized-promotion case.
Available forkability bypasses the forkability checkpoint in the authorized-promotion case.
Present consequential authorization selects report after all non-capture guards pass.
